label: throw()
type: the general-purpose JavaScript exception primitive underlying every sync-function rejection path - require*()'s shared 'signals rejection by throwing an exception' language and channel()/access()'s own rollback-on-rejection behaviour are all instances of this one mechanism. Preferred usage is throw({forbidden: "..."}), which becomes an HTTP 403 response's message.
note: The primitive the four require*() commands are documented as convenience wrappers around, per this batch's own cross-page comparison (see reconciliation.md round 27).
